rules.title: Prohibition Against Algorithmic Rent-Fixing in the Rental Housing Market
rules.requirement: Landlords of any residential dwelling unit in Hoboken may not price-fix using algorithmic pricing. That means using software, algorithms, or data-sharing platforms to collect and analyze nonpublic competitor information in order to coordinate, recommend, or implement rental prices, lease terms, or occupancy levels among competing lessors. Nonpublic competitor information includes prices, supply levels, security deposits, ideal occupancy levels, lease termination and renewal dates, and other material terms. It must be less than 365 days old and not widely and readily available to the public at no cost. The Division of Housing or an aggrieved private citizen may bring violations in Hoboken Municipal Court.
rules.key_value: Fine not exceeding $2,000, or penalties under N.J.S.A. 40:49-5 (the penalty list is cut off in the passage); enforced by the Division of Housing or an aggrieved private citizen in Municipal Court.

coverage.summary: Any residential dwelling unit (any primary residence), excluding medical/long-term care or detention facilities, in Hoboken.

rules.exemptions: Medical/long-term care and detention facilities are excluded from 'residential dwelling unit'.
rules.effective_date_note: The passages show the ordinance as adopted on Jul 9, 2025 but do not state an effective date.
citation_aliases: Ordinance amending Chapter 158 (Rent Increases) adding Section 158-2
rules.quoted_span: Landlords who rent any residential dwelling unit (defined as any primary residence excluding medical/long-term care or detention facilities) in the City of Hoboken are prohibited from price fixing using algorithmic pricing.
rules.review_note: The passage text is truncated. The new section is labeled § 158-2 in the title but § 154-8 in the body, and both labels are listed as aliases. Status is treated as in force because the ordinance was adopted in 2025 and the query date is 2026-10-01, but the effective date is not stated.
rules.source_notes: The enforcement and penalty details come from a second passage of the same ordinance (p3).
